model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the LIT/USD price on Kraken reaches or exceeds $5.00 at any point during October 2026 (UTC).
- "No": Wins if the LIT/USD price on Kraken remains below $5.00 throughout the entirety of October 2026 (UTC).

Clarifications:
- "Reaches $5.00" means the LIT/USD last traded price (or mark price) on Kraken is recorded at $5.00 or higher at any moment from 00:00 UTC on October 1, 2026 through 23:59:59 UTC on October 31, 2026.
- If LIT is no longer traded under the ticker LIT on Kraken due to a rebrand or migration, the equivalent successor token's USD price on Kraken (or its CoinGecko USD aggregate if delisted) is used instead.
